title: stryker.com site classification and import order
status: APPROVED 2026-10-27: import order, outlier approach and pilot
evidence: tools/importer/data/catalog/site.json and xf-report.json (2,553 page exports, cq:template)
outlierNote: Pages grouped by their exact component set split too finely to call outliers (e.g. product-detail: 449 sets, 386 used once). Proposal: classify outliers per template during that template’s analysis by the components it needs that its importer does not map yet (component-map.json status decide/unmapped), not by exact set.
proposedImportOrder: 1. XF fragments (xf-index, published variations used by pages) — once, before any page
3. news-detail (710; 79 already migrated → re-import under the new rules, diffed)
12. small templates: contactdivision, packagedetail, division, news-landing, tier1-*, portfolio, event-calendar, external-asset-library, tier1-landing-services
13. singletons: home, search (already migrated → re-import diffed)
reimport: Already-migrated pages are re-imported under the approved tables; each page is diffed against the current content; differences are fixed in the importers, never per page (memory rule: re-import must not regress author edits; DA patched only on request).

pilot.why: prove the new importers and decision tables before overwriting the 81 already-migrated pages
pilot.where: pilot pages are imported under /drafts/reimport/<source path> (local preview /content/drafts/reimport/...); fragments go to their real /us/en/fragments/... paths (they are new documents; the 7 existing shared ones re-import unchanged, verified 2026-10-27)
pilot.pages: a representative set: ~5 news-detail incl. already-migrated ones, Smart Care (division), 2-3 product-detail, 1 tier2-landing-page, 1 long-page-detail, 1 contact directory (content fragments)
pilot.check: preview at 600/900/1200 vs source, diff vs the current migrated content for the already-migrated ones, link check, style validator offered
pilot.then: if everything checks out: re-import the already-migrated pages to their real paths (diffed), remove the pilot copies, continue with the import order
